title: Initial Health Appointment
note: Reviewed set. The LLM draft from `extract_requirements` is saved next to this file as APL26-001.draft.json for comparison.

requirements.obligation: Complete an IHA for every Member.
requirements.quote: An IHA must be completed for all Members

requirements.obligation: Periodically re-administer the IHA according to the PHM Policy Guide and MCP Contract.
requirements.quote: periodically re-administered according to requirements in the PHM Policy Guide and MCP Contract requirements

requirements.obligation: The IHA must be performed by a Provider within the primary care medical setting (general practice, pediatrics, obstetrics, gynecology, internal medicine).
requirements.quote: Must be performed by a Provider within the primary care medical setting.

requirements.obligation: An IHA may be skipped only if the Member's PCP determines the Medical Record is complete and was updated within the previous 12 months.
requirements.quote: Is not necessary if the Member’s Primary Care Provider (PCP) determines that the Member's Medical Record contains complete information that was updated within the previous 12 months.

requirements.obligation: Provide the IHA in a culturally and linguistically appropriate way.
requirements.quote: Must be provided in a way that is culturally and linguistically appropriate for the Member.

requirements.obligation: Document the IHA in the Member's Medical Record.
requirements.quote: Must be documented in the Member’s Medical Record.

requirements.obligation: The IHA must include a history of the Member's physical and mental health.
requirements.quote: A history of the Member's physical and mental health;

requirements.obligation: The IHA must include an identification of risks.
The IHA must include an assessment of need for preventive screens or services.
requirements.quote: An assessment of need for preventive screens or services;

requirements.obligation: The IHA must include health education.
The IHA must include the diagnosis and plan for treatment of any diseases.
requirements.quote: The diagnosis and plan for treatment of any diseases.

requirements.obligation: For Members dually eligible for Medi-Cal and Medicare, follow the IHA requirements in the PHM Policy Guide and MCP Contract.
requirements.quote: For Members who are dually eligible for Medi-Cal and Medicare, MCPs must adhere to the IHA requirements in the PHM Policy Guide and MCP Contract.

requirements.obligation: Do not require the IHEBA or Staying Healthy Assessment as a component of the IHA; those requirements were removed.
requirements.quote: are no longer required components of the IHA beginning January 1, 2023

requirements.obligation: Within 90 calendar days of the APL's release, submit updated P&Ps to the MCOD-MCP Submission Portal, or an attestation that no changes are needed.
requirements.quote: the MCP must submit its updated P&Ps to the Managed Care Operations Division (MCOD)-MCP Submission Portal within 90 calendar days of the release of this APL

requirements.obligation: An attestation must include the APL title and its release date in the subject line.
requirements.quote: The attestation must include the title of this APL as well as the applicable APL release date in the subject line.

requirements.obligation: Ensure Subcontractors and Network Providers comply, and communicate these requirements to all of them.
requirements.quote: These requirements must be communicated by each MCP to all Subcontractors and Network Providers.
